details.name: Search By Image (by Google)
details.who: All Firefox users who have this add-on installed.
details.why:
The Search By Image (by Google) extension causes very high CPU utilization during regular browsing, often damaging user experience significantly, in a way that is very difficult to associate with the extension.

Users who want to continue using the add-on regardless of its performance impact can enable it in the Add-ons Manager.
